readiness_interpretation: Completes runtime prerequisites without rewriting historical source-use bindings. Every new acquisition still requires current matching notices and schema, a shared publisher lease and durable operation history.
checkpoint_contract: Start before any request; current notice and schema evidence before CSV; committed parent acquisition reference preserved even if cancelled before terminal success.
cancellation: Cooperative IPC and AbortSignal; finish bounded local committed-evidence finalization, preserve completed bundles and history, release only the owned publisher gate after handover pacing.
retention: Internal selected records and notices; local-review normalization. No raw CSV, rejected personal values, automatic deletion or inferred physical sites.
